title: Chidi's AI-written essay
caption: Using AI to write your scholarship essay? 🤖 Use it to brainstorm and check grammar, NOT to invent your story. Committees can tell, and some programs ban it. Save this 📌 #ai #chatgpt #scholarship #statementofpurpose

scenes.backdrop: dark bedroom late at night lit by a laptop screen and a small lamp

beats.text: Quddus! I finished my scholarship essay in two minutes. AI wrote it. It's beautiful.
beats.say: Kuddus! I finished my scholarship essay in two minutes. A.I. wrote it. It's beautiful.
Ever since I was a child in the vibrant streets of my city, my passion for innovation has burned like a thousand suns.
Chidi. A thousand suns? The committee has read that sun many times.

scenes.backdrop: calm café with soft lights, plants and a notebook on the table

beats.text: So I can't use AI at all?
beats.say: So I can't use A.I. at all?
Use it as a helper, not as the writer. Brainstorm ideas, check grammar, or ask it what's unclear. But the story and the facts must be yours.

beats.text: Some programs ban AI-written essays. And generic text is easy to spot. Your real experience is what makes you stand out.
beats.say: Some programs ban A.I.-written essays. And generic text is easy to spot. Your real experience is what makes you stand out.
New first line: in my final year, I fixed my school's broken water pump with a phone charger. True story!
